title: A LATE TEAMMATE SEES THE MAP MARKERS ALREADY PLACED
why: A map marker goes out to the party once, when it is placed. A teammate who joined the raid in progress never saw the host marker (or another teammate marker) placed before he came up. The join answer now sends the markers already placed, but never his own back.
now: JOIN THE RAID IN PROGRESS: map markers your party already placed show for the teammate who joins.
